dogecoin.text: I've been trying to build a computer for THREE YEARS NOW, and suddenly, when I finally have near enough to finish it, stupid Dogecoin or whatever it is this time come and they screw everything up.

And before I get accused of being a cryptobro shill: I don't have any Bitcoin, Dogecoin, Ethereum, or NFTs.  I think Cryptocurrency is stupid Monopoly money, and if you do it, you're a sucker.  But I'm not gonna treat you like you killed a basket full of puppies for it.
